about: The r3x round-2 humour film v135-blocked-gate (run 40582276259, req r-r3x2hu-0001, 2026-10-27/28, stopped at the film gate at 7/12 twice, never voiced) replayed: the panel of 2026-10-28 named its faults.

pitches.logline: Gio needs to leave for work, but an unknown black SUV blocks the courtyard gate. Nobody answers the horn, and there is no number behind the glass.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: Gio's horn blares at the SUV parked across the gate, sound horn-short
pitches.heroObject: the black SUV across the gate

pitches.logline: Levan bought a diesel SUV because diesel is cheap. At the pump the board says otherwise, and the queue honks.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: the car behind honks as Levan stares at the pump's counter, sound horn-short

pitches.logline: Nika drives the wedding cake to Mtskheta, then misses the last turn to the venue while the guests honk behind him.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: a guest's horn as Nika brakes past the venue gate, sound horn-short
pitches.heroObject: the cake box on the seat

treatment.logline: Gio needs to leave his Saburtalo courtyard at 8 am, but an unknown black SUV blocks the gate; nobody answers the horn and there is no number behind its glass.
treatment.hero: Gio, a made-up office worker, and the one black SUV across his gate
treatment.obstacle: the SUV's owner cannot be reached: no number, no note, nobody comes down

hook.event: the horn blares on frame 0 at the black SUV across the gate

act1: he honks again and nobody comes down
the SUV's windshield has no number and no note
Gio loses it and yells at the car
treatment.turn: the shout freezes on the hinge word, then the twist: Geostat, 19 October 2026, car re-exports down 24 % in nine months

reveal.what: the QR card: a card behind the glass, whoever scans it messages the owner, no number shown

screens.step: open the QR card from the menu
the card, printed and put behind the glass
the passer-by scans it and taps the car is blocking me

treatment.payoff: had the SUV a card behind its glass, Gio would just have scanned it and messaged the owner, no number needed
treatment.signature: the SUV on a greyscale card, the marker ringing its empty windshield where a number would be
treatment.heroObject: the black SUV across the gate

post.description: სამსახურში გაგვიანდება, მეზობლებიც უკან გელოდებიან და ჯიპის პატრონი არსად ჩანს. შენ რას აკეთებ, როცა ასე ჩაგკეტავენ?

beats.say: საქსტატი, ოქტომბერი: | მანქანების გადაყიდვა | ოცდაოთხი პროცენტით დაეცა.
ჰოდა, რჩებიან. | ქიუარ ბარათით | პატრონს მიწერდი.
beats.show: ჰოდა, რჩებიან. | QR ბარათით | პატრონს მიწერდი.
